summary: Mattermost REST v4 client (agents/mattermost.py) for the StranglerRoom e2e demo driver
prompt: Write agents/mattermost.py: a production-quality, typed, documented Mattermost REST v4 client used by scripts/run_e2e_demo.py (docs/AGENTS_SPEC.md section 3; docs/SWITCH_PROTOCOL.md section 6.5 shows the REST calls as user `user`, including that the login token is the `Token` RESPONSE HEADER). The binding API contract is the module docstring of tests/test_mattermost_client.py, exercised against tests/fake_mattermost.py (read its docstring: it reproduces the real server's `since` quirks — older thread roots and older-but-edited posts are returned, deleted posts come back with delete_at>0). Implement exactly: `class MattermostError(RuntimeError)` (attributes status, method, url, body; str contains the status and the server's JSON `message` when present); `class MattermostClient(base_url, *, timeout=15.0)` with one httpx.Client (base_url = <root stripped of trailing slash> + '/api/v4'), context manager + close(), login(user, password) -> dict, me(), channel(channel_id), team(name), user_by_username(username), post(channel_id, message, root_id='') -> dict, posts_since(channel_id, since_ms) -> list[dict], wait_for(channel_id, predicate, *, since_ms, timeout, poll=1.0) -> dict. Requirements: every non-2xx raises MattermostError (fail loud, no silent fallbacks, no retries that hide errors); login raises MattermostError when a 2xx response lacks the Token header; posts_since returns only create_at > since_ms, drops delete_at>0 and non-empty `type` posts, sorts ascending by create_at, adds 'username' resolved through ONE batched POST /users/ids call per posts_since for ids not yet in an instance cache (never re-requesting known ids), raising MattermostError if the server omits a requested id; wait_for uses time.monotonic for the deadline, sleeps `poll` between polls, returns the earliest matching post, and on timeout raises TimeoutError('no post matched within <timeout>s in channel <id>; last posts seen: ...') listing up to the last 10 posts seen as 'username: message' (message truncated to 200 chars, newlines collapsed). Only dependency: httpx (already installed) and the standard library. Use `from __future__ import annotations`, no print statements, a module docstring explaining purpose and the quirks handled. Do not write any other file.
